citation: Troiano, Pado and Klinger (2019), Crowdsourcing and Validating Event-focused Emotion Corpora for German and English, ACL.
licence: ODC-By 1.0; original licence and attribution retained
overlap_policy: Exact normalized case/whitespace comparison against all raw original benchmark splits; near-duplicates and pretraining exposure not ruled out.
primary_endpoint: External supported four-class macro-F1, app passage mean; all six model outputs remain possible. Original author prompt labels are targets. No target fine-tuning.
secondary_endpoints: Whole-entry inference; unsupported-class abstention; synthetic mixed/neutral performance; daily passage-frequency MAE and adjacent-day direction agreement.
trend_definition: Mean of entry passage-label frequencies per observed day; neutral/uncertain contributes zero to six emotions. Calendar-adjacent pairs only, delta deadband 0.05. This is a diagnostic frequency measure, not the app softmax chart or mood intensity.
synthetic_limit: AI-authored non-independent stress test; no human pilot or clinical validation.
